about_the_game:
Become the Master of Molten Steel

Welcome to Droak’s forge. This is no ordinary workshop — every hammer strike, every spark is part of a legend in the making.

A Realistic Blacksmithing Simulation

  • Gather Ore – Roam the mountains and uncover iron, copper, and gold veins

  • Heat the Metal – Watch the steel glow and hit the perfect temperature

  • Forge on the Anvil – Strike the right spot with the right force. Every weapon has its own forging technique

  • Create Legends – Swords, axes, daggers… Fulfill your customers’ demands

Race Against Time

The day–night cycle flows in real time. Head to the mines at sunrise, fire up the furnace in the evening, and finish orders by nightfall. Every day brings new opportunities — and new challenges.

Upgrade Your Workshop

Spend your hard-earned gold on new tools and more powerful furnaces. Start with a simple hammer and work your way up to legendary blacksmith sets.

The Village Needs You

Every morning, new orders arrive in your mailbox. A farmer’s sickle, a knight’s sword… each request has its own story. Deliver on time and build your reputation.
